Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the correct award information. The search results clearly showed a PDF from the official Sangeet Natak Akademi website (sangeetnatak.gov.in) listing "Shiv Kumar Sharma" as the recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1986 (along with Padma Shri and Padma Vibhushan mentions for the same person). The WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that Anil Biswas received the award in 1986 based on an unverified snippet from DuckDuckGo's AI summary, without actually reading the official document which explicitly named Shiv Kumar Sharma. This led to a false conclusion about the award winner.
